description: This file defines the ThingsMetadataSource class, which provides a reactive source of metadata from a Things service. It interacts with messaging and streaming actors to fetch and transform streamed snapshots of things into Metadata objects, including filtering and conversion logic.

classes.name: ThingsMetadataSource
classes.description: Final class providing a reactive stream of Metadata objects by interacting with streaming actors and processing streamed snapshots of things stored in a distributed pub-sub system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ThingsMetadataSource with specified ActorRef, burst size, and idle timeout.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Starts and returns a Source of Metadata objects, beginning from the provided lowerBound ThingId, by requesting and processing streamed snapshots.

methods.name: getStartStreamCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command object to initiate streaming snapshots, optionally using a lowerBound to resume from a specific point.

methods.name: requestStream
methods.description: Requests a SourceRef of streamed snapshots from the pub-sub mediator actor, handling the asynchronous response.

methods.name: getStreamedSnapshots
methods.description: Converts a SourceRef into a Source of StreamedSnapshot, mapping elements and enforcing type checking.

methods.name: toMetadata
methods.description: Converts a StreamedSnapshot into an Optional<Metadata> object, extracting fields and handling exceptions.
